author: Boscodog
notes_extra: 300 otm. Standard edge, 28 in Bartlein. He signed the post Tom. H1000 reached 2800 fps and hammered the brass, with no charge given for that powder.

author: RUM MAN
notes_extra: 300 gr. Otm. 15 thou off. Remington action, 29 in Kreiger heavy Palma. Three in one hole at 100 yards. He wrote 338 Edges.

author: mabia
notes_extra: 300 gr Berger OTM. Base to ogive 3.065 is not COAL. 30 in Bartlein 1 in 9.5. MagnetoSpeed. He said a standard Edge. He signed the post Randy.

author: mabia
notes_extra: Same Edge and bullet as the 102 gr load. Cooler weather. A few primer pockets in warmer weather. MagnetoSpeed.

author: EdgeFan
notes_extra: 300gr OTM. Seated at 3.228 CBTO on a Hornady comparator, .015 off the lands. CBTO is not COAL. He said 93 gr looked like the sweet spot. At 94 gr the primers started to flatten and the group went to hell. He wrote my new edge. The thread is a standard 338 Edge.

author: ABC1000
notes_extra: Berger 300 OTM Hybrids. Jumping .030. A hair of pressure. Just over 2,900 fps, and later 2,890-2,910 ish while the barrel was speeding up. MOA or better at 1,000 yards. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 338 Lapua Mag.
